 Micron: The 5x P/E Isn't As Cheap As It Looks, But The Upside Remains
 Oct 29, 2026, 5:02 PM ET Micron Technology, Inc. (MU) Stock , MU:CA Stock , ZMIC:CA Stock SKHY 20 Comments 1 Like Research Wise 1.47K Followers Follow Summary
 Micron Technology, Inc. is rated a Buy, driven by robust AI-fueled demand, tight memory supply, and strong pricing power supporting exceptional FY26 results.
 MU delivered Q4 FY26 revenue of $54.22B (up 379% YoY), with gross margins over 87% and EPS of $33.42, far surpassing consensus estimates.
 AI infrastructure, data centers, automotive, and robotics end-markets are expected to sustain elevated demand and pricing through FY27–FY28, with strategic agreements providing strong visibility.
 Despite cyclical risks and recent stock underperformance, MU's low valuation multiple and favorable supply-demand dynamics offer meaningful upside potential.
